classification: test-gate integration of documented native DR tasks; no production or supply-chain change

specific_source_checks.controller/volume_controller.go: checkAndInitVolumeRestore sets restoreInitiated and restoreRequired; checkAndFinishVolumeRestore waits actual Engine lastRestoredBackup and clears restoreRequired only on completion; detached before initialization cannot prove restoration.
specific_source_checks.datastore/kubernetes.go: NewPVManifestForVolume/NewPVManifest provide Retain static PV with existing native volumeHandle and matching claim binding. Explicit claim UID prebinding avoids dynamic replacement.
specific_source_checks.k8s/pkg/apis/longhorn/v1beta2/volumeatta: AttachmentTickets are native attachment intents; source fence requires no tickets.
specific_source_checks.k8s/pkg/apis/longhorn/v1beta2/enginefron: EngineFrontend is the V2 business endpoint, separate from internal Engine export.

product_entry: Existing source/target config.yml + kubecli setup09 for installation and each snapshot/backup request. Documented native Volume API for standby/activation/disableFrontend and native static PV/PVC for existing restored volumes; never replace installation/backup evidence with direct Helm or clients.

activation.assertions: Full then changed incremental source backup and standby actual restoration; workflow refuses absent fence without calling native activation. Retire original fixture writer/claim/Retain PV, detach normally, disable frontend, verify no PV/claim/Pods/tickets and stopped Engine/EngineFrontend. Record and re-read same source proof before native activation. Bind original target Volume through static PV/PVC, read latest confirmed source hash, confirm target-side write and unchanged source fence.

failback.prerequisite: The activation focused branch must first pass, with scoped cleanup and current frozen dependencies.
failback.assertions: New target full backup with each referenced object read/hashed; source discovers original backup URL and restores a new V2 three-replica native volume. Require restore initialization/completion and original source URL. Retire target writer/PVC/PV and verify reverse fence before mounting new main-site claim. New UID must differ from both obsolete original and recovery volume, and old source remains fenced. Confirm recovered target writes and a new main-site write.
failback.prerequisite_enforcement: The fixed shell entry checks activation evidence and unchanged full business Python dependencies, both installation identities and independently verified empty baselines before any transport or fixture cleanup. The shell-only added prerequisite guard does not change already-qualified activation behavior; its deterministic contracts exercise missing, incomplete, drifted and unclean evidence.

fixture_boundary: Exact original three-node source and independent one-node target installations; new original source workload, one standby/recovery native volume, own target static namespace/PV/PVC/client and optional new source return volume with separate context journal. Both installations and original raw media are preserved.
cleanup: Before backend or cache disconnection, retire restore/recovery consumers and exact owned native targets. Verify all UID/spec/claim bindings and full namespace graph, refuse unknown creation outcomes. Restore target cache then source cache while proving external backup receipts unchanged; clean business journals/namespaces and original source through existing guard, restore original credentials/references, then original source Store removes its own backend/transports. Restore both Registry channels and control kubeconfig; compare both empty baselines.
failure_diagnostics: Private durable first failure, exact rendered inputs and context journals, both clusters native volume/engine/frontend/replica/attachment/backup graph, Pod descriptions/events and Manager logs. Never print credentials or persist supplied passwords.
coverage_boundary: Planned fixture handoff with independently verifiable software fencing; not a hypervisor power-off/BMC or sudden complete source-site loss exercise. Native Longhorn API cannot establish remote-site fencing. Single-node target does not demonstrate target-site node HA. Activation qualification does not sign off failback or complete LONGHORN-48.

full_module.classification: test-gate composition only; no product, images or individual business assertion change
full_module.coverage: 10 independently qualified child workflows: integrity includes snapshots; SystemBackup includes independent full/incremental backup recovery; failback includes independent TLS, two-point standby and guarded activation. Other children cover backup refusal, four recurring paths, detached periodic full and absent-volume SystemRestore.
full_module.cleanup: Each child owns its recovery and must emit scoped-clean. Stop on its first unmet prerequisite; preserve child logs. Aggregate owns only its private logs and checks both original baselines before/after. Healthy source and target installations remain.
